claims.name: initialize
claims.behavior: Advertise only capabilities implied by this allowlist; unknown optional capabilities remain false or absent.

claims.name: launch
claims.behavior: Launch exactly one owned identity-bound Component using the already accepted invocation grants.

claims.name: setBreakpoints
claims.behavior: Accept only unconditional source line breakpoints; condition, hitCondition and logMessage are typed-refused; every line is verified, rejected or reported unbound.

claims.name: configurationDone
claims.behavior: Begin or resume the owned launch only after its accepted configuration sequence.

claims.name: threads
claims.behavior: Return one logical Script execution in M10; no native thread or parallel task claim.

claims.name: stackTrace
claims.behavior: Return at most 256 ordered source-mapped frames for the selected logical execution.

claims.name: scopes
claims.behavior: Expose fixed read-only locals, arguments and result scopes only when Runtime data exists.

claims.name: variables
claims.behavior: Return read-only redacted values with depth 8 and 256 children per container; unavailable values are labeled unavailable.

claims.name: continue
claims.behavior: Resume the stopped execution and emit exactly one matching continued event.

claims.name: pause
claims.behavior: Stop only through a proven Runtime safe-pause hook; absence of that hook makes STEP-0100 NO-GO.

claims.name: disconnect
claims.behavior: Cancel or terminate the adapter-owned launch and leave no paused process, worker or session state.

claims.name: terminate
claims.behavior: Enter the shared typed cancellation path and publish one terminal outcome.

claims.name: attach
claims.behavior: Refuse arbitrary process or Store attachment.

claims.name: next
claims.behavior: Refuse source stepping in v0.

claims.name: stepIn
claims.behavior: Refuse source stepping in v0.

claims.name: stepOut
claims.behavior: Refuse source stepping in v0.

claims.name: evaluate
claims.behavior: Refuse arbitrary guest expression execution.

claims.name: setExpression
claims.behavior: Refuse guest expression mutation.

claims.name: setVariable
claims.behavior: Refuse mutation of observed values.

claims.name: readMemory
claims.behavior: Refuse native or guest memory reads.

claims.name: writeMemory
claims.behavior: Refuse native or guest memory mutation.

claims.name: disassemble
claims.behavior: Refuse native or Component disassembly.

claims.name: setFunctionBreakpoints
claims.behavior: Refuse function breakpoints; only unconditional source lines are claimed.

claims.name: setDataBreakpoints
claims.behavior: Refuse data breakpoints.

claims.name: setInstructionBreakpoints
claims.behavior: Refuse Component/native instruction breakpoints.

claims.name: setExceptionBreakpoints
claims.behavior: Refuse exception filter configuration; only accepted breakpoint and fault reasons stop.

claims.name: restartFrame
claims.behavior: Refuse frame or control-flow rewrite.

claims.name: goto
claims.behavior: Refuse control-flow rewrite.

claims.name: stepBack
claims.behavior: Refuse reverse execution.

claims.name: reverseContinue
claims.behavior: Refuse reverse execution.

claims.name: restart
claims.behavior: Refuse in-session restart; persistent generations remain isolated launches.

claims.name: terminateThreads
claims.behavior: Refuse independent logical-thread termination in M10.

claims.name: initialized
claims.behavior: Emit once after the adapter capabilities are fixed.

claims.name: stopped
claims.behavior: Carry a typed stop reason and valid logical execution identity.

claims.name: continued
claims.behavior: Match one accepted continue and report the affected logical execution set exactly.

claims.name: output
claims.behavior: Derive bounded redacted output from sico.execution-event.v0.

claims.name: terminated
claims.behavior: Emit once after the owned session reaches its terminal outcome.

claims.name: exited
claims.behavior: Carry the stable process or runner exit code when one exists.
